note: Set A is preferred because it correctly extracts the critical substrate slope (1/4" per foot) for the shower pan, which Set B omits entirely. Both sets share significant errors: they both misread the 3" width dimension as subfloor thickness and misbind the 3/4" MDF specification to the edge strip instead of the gable. Set A contains more duplicate claims (e.g., scale, tile thickness), but the inclusion of the slope makes it the more complete and useful engineering record.
remarks: Both extractors fail to distinguish between the 'EDGE STRIP' and the adjacent '3/4" MDF GABLE' label in Detail D3, and both hallucinate a '3" SUBFLOOR FIN.' quote by concatenating separate text elements in Detail D1.
